overview: Built an automated procurement and vendor management system for handling purchase requests, vendor onboarding, quotation comparison, approvals, purchase orders, and delivery tracking.

The workflow takes a new purchase request and turns it into a complete procurement process with automated budget checks, vendor evaluation, approvals, document management, and final delivery verification.

list: Receives purchase requests through a webhook
Creates and validates procurement records automatically
Checks department budget before processing
Searches approved vendors based on the requested category
Starts vendor onboarding when no suitable vendor is available
Creates vendor folders and stores compliance documents in Google Drive
Extracts and analyzes vendor documents using AI
Calculates vendor compliance scores and approval status
Sends RFQs to approved vendors automatically
Receives and stores vendor quotations
Extracts pricing, delivery, warranty, and payment terms from quotes
Compares vendors using weighted scoring
Generates an AI based vendor recommendation
Routes purchases through manager, finance, and director approvals
Generates the final purchase order automatically
Sends documents for digital signature through DocuSign
Sends the approved purchase order to the selected vendor
Tracks active purchase orders and delivery deadlines
Sends reminders and late delivery alerts
Verifies received goods against the original order
Updates vendor performance and procurement status
Updates procurement analytics automatically

blocks.p: The workflow uses predefined procurement, RFQ, approval, and purchase order templates.

list: Vendor communication
RFQ structure
Approval requests
Purchase order details
Delivery notifications

blocks.p: This keeps the procurement process consistent across different departments and vendors.
Airtable acts as the central procurement and vendor tracking system.

list: Request status
Budget approval
Selected vendor
Vendor score
Purchase order number
Approval status
Delivery status
Vendor performance

result: A complete automated procurement pipeline that turns a purchase request into an approved, documented, signed, tracked, and completed purchase order without requiring teams to manually manage every procurement step.
The system also keeps vendor documents, quotations, approvals, delivery status, vendor performance, and procurement analytics organized in one workflow.
